recent_items.summary: Memory enables language agents to carry useful distinctions from past experience into future decisions. Its value depends on which distinctions survive, whether a bounded agent can use them, and what can be recovered or revised as demands evolve. We develop a decision-theoretic framework that follows this value from raw history through persistent state, operational use, and costly recovery and revision. recent_items.summary: EnzyPair is a benchmark dataset for evaluating enzyme-function similarity at low sequence identity. It contains 1,664 same-EC4 protein pairs and 4,992 structure-matched different-EC4 controls involving 2,465 proteins. The release includes protein sequences, EC annotations, TM-align measurements, residue alignments, exclusion records, source provenance and software versions.
recent_items.title: EnzyPair: a dataset of same-function enzyme pairs with structure-matched controls at low sequence identity

recent_items.summary: Despite significant advances in deep learning-based failure prognosis, existing predictive maintenance frameworks consistently terminate at the prediction step, leaving the critical operational challenge of prioritising maintenance resources across heterogeneous asset fleets unresolved. This paper addresses this gap by proposing an integrated framework that couples Long Short-Term Memory network-based Remaining Useful Life prediction with the Technique for Order of Preference by Similarity to Id
recent_items.title: Code and analysis: A Deep Learning and TOPSIS Framework for Predictive Maintenance Scheduling in Smart Manufacturing: An Industry 4.0 Approach
